threshold_note: every aggregate moved by a solved terminal has a 72-flop 95% half-width above 0.005 (smallest: BTN jam 0.006; SB / BB-vs-SB / BB-vs-BTN 0.018-0.075); with h ~ 1/sqrt(boards) (assumed, not measured) 0.005 on SB raise would need ~(0.073/0.005)^2 x 72 ~ 15 000 boards per terminal

period2.node 28 (BB vs BTN): half-amplitude 0.002-0.011 = 0.13-0.19 of its half-width: negligible against panel noise
period2.node 6 (SB first-in, BB vs SB): half-amplitude 0.008-0.050 = 0.23-0.75 of its half-width: below noise, but not negligible

attribution: the two terminals act on disjoint aggregates: only28 reproduces 'both' for BTN first-in and BB vs BTN, only6 for SB first-in and BB vs SB; cross effects <= 0.0001; CO first-in is unaffected (0 spread)

unexpected_observation.what: the replicate distributions are not centred on P15: bootstrap mean - P15 = +0.053 SB raise, -0.039 SB fold, +0.055 BB-vs-SB fold, -0.082 BB-vs-SB call, +0.027 BB-vs-SB jam, +0.021 BB-vs-BTN fold, -0.033 BB-vs-BTN call; P15 lies at or outside the replicate range for BB vs SB (fold 0.014 < min 0.018; call 0.802 > max 0.789; jam 0.184 = min)
unexpected_observation.isolation: diagnostic (not pre-registered), one preflop solve on the mean of the 30 both-replicate tables: mean table vs A3 table shift is at the 30-sample noise level (mean |z| 0.60 / 0.66 for nodes 28 / 6), and f(mean table) stays close to P15 (BB-vs-SB fold 0.029, call 0.783; SB raise 0.527) while the mean of f(replicates) moves much further (0.069, 0.720, 0.554)
unexpected_observation.reading: the shift comes from the non-linear table -> preflop-strategy map under table noise (Jensen-type; BB-vs-SB fold sits at the 0 boundary), not from a biased table estimator. Panel noise therefore also displaces the aggregates systematically, by an amount of the same order as the half-width. A linear bootstrap bias correction is not usable here (it would give BB-vs-SB fold < 0)
unexpected_observation.consequence: the 95% half-width understates the total 72-flop error of the node 6 aggregates; precision_limited is the registered label, but the effective uncertainty of SB first-in / BB vs SB at P15 is about +/-0.05-0.10

limitation: the bootstrap measures the board-sampling sensitivity of P15 (one frozen-table preflop solve per resampled used table); it does not directly measure the noise of a fully re-converged outer fixed point; 30 replicates make the percentile interval coarse (2nd smallest / 2nd largest); the SD-based ratio d/(1.96 sd) gives the same classification (max 0.61)
